checks.message: Alert matches the agency record (M9.9, 48.200°N 153.400°E 140 km, issued 2026-10-16 12:40:02.6 JST). The agency itself published this content.
400 receipts spanning 1315 km; carriers ['au', 'rakuten', 'softbank']; channels ['cbs', 'jalert', 'tv']; 90 % of receipts within 3.0 s.

NATIONAL pattern (1315 km extent, 3 independent carriers, non-cellular channels ['jalert', 'tv']). A radio-layer spoof cannot produce this: it would need simultaneous rogue cells on every carrier across hundreds of km, plus control of broadcast TV/J-ALERT. The common point is upstream of the carriers.
Independent catalogue: M6.9 mww — 76 km NE of Ozernovskiy, Russia — 51.985°N 157.270°E 135 km at 2026-10-16 12:35:31.9 JST (fixture-kamchatka-20261016).
Alert parameters disagree with the real event: ΔM = +3.0 (≈31,623× the energy); epicentre 503 km away. The event is real; the alert's description of it is not.
M9.9 exceeds the largest instrumentally recorded earthquake (Chile 1960, Mw 9.5). Physically possible in principle, but as a prior it marks an estimator operating outside its envelope.

Agency detection 2026-10-16 12:38:10.1 JST vs. real event's P wave first reaching the network (Shiretoko/Rausu, 1259 km, 157.6 s travel) at 2026-10-16 12:38:09.5 JST: lag +0.6 s. The trigger WAS that earthquake's P wave.
